decisions.reason: As a sheet preparation module that builds directly on the firm's core postpress range and still had its own product page in 2024, it fits the company's automation-focused portfolio and shows no sign of withdrawal.

This folding add-on unit closely complements the firm's existing finishing systems, remained mentioned on the website in 2024, and had a referenced customer use case, so it is likely to stay as a modular upsell rather than be discontinued.
